# jamfpro_v1_return_to_service (Data Source)

Retrieve a Return to Service Configuration with the supplied id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Code generated by tfpfgen. DO NOT EDIT.

data "jamfpro_v1_return_to_service" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String)
- `id` (String) Id of the Return to Service Configuration.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `wifi_profile_id` (String) Id of the wifi profile that is associated with the return to service configuration.
